criteria.description: Every component, group, input, output, repeated block, and operation expected from the written description is visibly present in the candidate.
Components follow the sensible reading and processing order implied by the description.
All candidate content remains fully inside the SVG canvas.
Candidate components have no unintended overlaps or collisions; intentional container nesting is allowed.
Every directed source-to-target connection expected from the description is visibly present in the candidate.
Each visible arrow attaches to the correct description-expected source and target components with the correct direction.
Labels and content are complete, accurate, and meaningful for the description rather than missing, generic, or placeholder text.
Text stays inside its intended container without clipping, collision, or overflow.
Every text element meets the configured minimum rendered font size.
